# vendor/

Third-party code, committed verbatim. **Do not edit these files.**

## markdown2.py

- Upstream: https://github.com/trentm/python-markdown2
- Source: `lib/markdown2.py`
- Version: 2.5.6
- Pinned commit: `49104b740e7dc5e3219ff2dd7355d388a4dc6528`
- License: MIT (see the header of `markdown2.py`)

Vendored rather than installed so the site builds with a bare `python3` — no `pip`,
no virtualenv, no network. To update, re-download `lib/markdown2.py` at a newer
commit and update the pin above.
